reviews.question: Paraphrase ba lần cho mỗi câu, dùng đa dạng cấu trúc và từ vựng nhưng giữ nguyên hoàn toàn ý nghĩa gốc.
reviews.originalEssay:
Câu 1: "Many people believe that money is one of the most important factors in achieving happiness."
It is widely thought that financial wealth plays a key role in attaining personal happiness.
Numerous individuals are of the opinion that money is a fundamental element that leads to a fulfilling life.
Wealth is considered by many to be a primary determinant of human happiness.
Câu 2: "Some people say that the best way to improve public health is by increasing the number of sports facilities. Others, however, believe this would have little effect."
While a group of people argues that expanding sports amenities is the most effective measure to enhance community health, opponents contend that such an approach would yield minimal results.
On the one hand, it is argued that building more athletic facilities is the optimal solution for boosting public health; on the other hand, some maintain that this initiative would make hardly any difference.
Certain individuals believe that the most ideal method for promoting population health is to construct more recreational facilities, whereas others claim that this strategy would be largely ineffective.
reviews.overall: Em đã làm đủ ba cách viết cho mỗi câu và phần câu B giữ được hai quan điểm. Tuy nhiên, cả ba bản của câu A đều làm mờ ý tiền là một trong những yếu tố quan trọng nhất. Đặc biệt, “fundamental element” và “primary determinant” khiến tiền trở thành yếu tố nền tảng hoặc quyết định. Em viết lại sáu câu theo mẫu gợi ý, rồi tự kiểm tra từng bản có giữ đúng toàn bộ ý gốc hay không.

annotations.label: a1-meaning
annotations.title: Chưa giữ đủ mức độ
annotations.bodyMarkdown:

Dùng “is among the most important factors in achieving happiness”.

annotations.bodyMarkdown:

annotations.bodyMarkdown:
“A primary determinant” nói tiền quyết định hạnh phúc, mạnh hơn ý gốc.

Viết “Wealth is regarded by many as one of the most significant contributors to happiness”.

annotations.title: Chọn từ sát nghĩa hơn
annotations.bodyMarkdown:

reviews.question:
Advertisements are becoming more and more common in our everyday life.
Is it a positive or negative development?
reviews.originalEssay:
Advertisements are becoming increasingly common in our daily lives, especially on television, social media and websites. In my opinion, this is a negative development because advertisements can encourage unnecessary consumption and negatively affect people’s choices.

One major disadvantage of the growing number of advertisements is that they can encourage people to buy things they do not really need. For example, attractive advertisements for clothes, electronic devices and fast food may make consumers feel that they need to purchase these products to have a better lifestyle. As a result, people may waste money on unnecessary items. Moreover, children and teenagers can be particularly influenced by advertisements because they may not fully understand the persuasive purpose behind them.

reviews.question:
Some people regard video games as harmless fun, or even as a useful educational tool. Others, however, believe that video games are having an adverse effect on the people who play them.
In your opinion, do the drawbacks of video games outweigh the benefits?
reviews.originalEssay:
Nowadays, video games have become increasingly popular among people of all ages. While some people believe that they provide entertainment and educational benefits, others argue that they have negative effects on players. In my opinion, the drawbacks of video games outweigh their benefits if people spend too much time playing them.

On the one hand, video games offer several advantages. Firstly, they are an effective way to relax after a long day of studying or working. In addition, some educational games can help children improve their problem-solving skills, creativity and memory. For example, games that require players to solve puzzles can encourage logical thinking. Furthermore, multiplayer games allow people to communicate and cooperate with others, which may improve their teamwork skills.

On the other hand, I believe that the disadvantages of video games are more significant. One major problem is that spending too much time playing games can negatively affect people’s physical and mental health. For instance, players may suffer from a lack of exercise, poor sleep and eye strain. Moreover, excessive gaming can distract students from their studies and lead to lower academic performance. Some violent games may also expose young players to inappropriate content. As a result, they may find it difficult to balance gaming with their daily responsibilities.

In conclusion, although video games can provide entertainment and educational benefits, I believe that their disadvantages outweigh their advantages when they are played excessively. Therefore, people should limit their gaming time and choose suitable games to enjoy the benefits while avoiding potential problems.

reviews.question:
It is now possible for scientists and tourists to travel to remote areas with natural environments, such as the South Pole.
Is this a positive or negative development?
reviews.originalEssay:
Nowadays, travelling to remote areas with natural environments, such as the South Pole, has become increasingly possible for scientists and tourists. Although this development may bring some benefits, I believe it is largely a negative trend because of its harmful effects on the environment.


On the one hand, travelling to remote areas offers several advantages. Firstly, scientists can explore these places to learn more about wildlife, climate change and the natural environment. This research may help them develop solutions to global environmental problems. In addition, tourism can provide people with unique experiences and a better understanding of the importance of protecting nature. Visitors may also share their experiences with others and raise public awareness of environmental issues.


On the other hand, I believe that the disadvantages of this development are more significant. The main concern is that human activities can damage fragile ecosystems. For example, tourists may leave rubbish behind, disturb wildlife or cause pollution through transportation. Moreover, remote environments such as the South Pole are particularly sensitive to climate change, so even a small amount of human activity may have long-term consequences. Another problem is that organising trips to these areas requires expensive equipment and transportation, which can consume considerable energy and produce greenhouse gas emissions.


In conclusion, although travelling to remote areas can support scientific research and provide valuable experiences, I believe that its negative effects on the environment outweigh its benefits. Therefore, such activities should be carefully controlled to protect these natural environments for future generations.
reviews.overall: Cô ghi nhận em viết câu khá chính xác và dùng “may/can” đúng để nói về khả năng. Tuy nhiên, bài đang kết luận việc đến vùng xa là tiêu cực, trái với hướng có lợi Cô giao; hai đoạn thân cũng chuyển thành lợi–hại thay vì lần lượt nói lợi cho khách du lịch và nhà khoa học. Em cần viết lại đủ ví dụ đảo ít người biết, phản biện về truyền hình, rồi nối nghiên cứu virus và biến đổi khí hậu với việc phòng dịch, phục hồi môi trường sống. Viết Body 2 về những câu hỏi khoa học chưa được giải đáp; dùng ví dụ virus mới và tác động của nóng lên toàn cầu đến sinh vật/môi trường sống, rồi nối đến phòng dịch và phục hồi nơi sống.

anchors.quote: On the other hand, I believe that the disadvantages of this development are more significant. The main concern is that human activities can damage fragile ecosystems. For example, tourists may leave rubbish behind, disturb wildlife or cause pollution through transportation. Moreover, remote environments such as the South Pole are particularly sensitive to climate change, so even a small amount of human activity may have long-term consequences. Another problem is that organising trips to these areas requires expensive equipment and transportation, which can consume considerable energy and produce greenhouse gas emissions.

annotations.title: Kết bài phải theo hướng có lợi
annotations.bodyMarkdown:
Em đã nhắc lại hai nhóm lợi ích nhưng lại kết luận tác hại trội hơn và thêm giải pháp kiểm soát, không đúng lập trường và dàn ý của bài này.

In conclusion, unfamiliar experiences for tourists and useful scientific knowledge make access to remote natural areas a positive development.

anchors.quote: In conclusion, although travelling to remote areas can support scientific research and provide valuable experiences, I believe that its negative effects on the environment outweigh its benefits. Therefore, such activities should be carefully controlled to protect these natural environments for future generations.

reviews.suggestedRevision:
The growing ability of researchers and travellers to reach isolated natural regions is a significant development. I am firmly convinced that this access is positive because it can offer tourists unfamiliar experiences and help scientists answer important questions.

Tourists, in particular, can benefit from visiting places that few people have seen. No matter how many attractions there are around the world, globetrotters still crave novelty. For example, on an island unknown to most people, visitors may take part in the religious practices of indigenous communities, observe rarely seen plants and animals, try unfamiliar food and experience a different way of life. These encounters allow travellers to discover the place for themselves. Granted, one might say that the same sights and customs can be seen on television channels devoted to travel. However, watching them on a screen is far inferior to taking part in these activities and seeing the surroundings in person.

Scientists can also gain valuable knowledge by exploring remote natural environments. Regardless of how much is already known about the world, many scientific questions remain unanswered, and visits to such places can help researchers investigate them. This can be seen in the way novel viruses emerge from time to time and global warming affects elusive animals and their habitats in heavily wooded areas and deep under the sea. By studying these phenomena, scientists may be better prepared for future outbreaks that could kill millions of people. The knowledge gained may also enable damaged habitats to be restored. These outcomes show how research in remote places can address both existing and future problems.

In conclusion, the chance to experience unfamiliar places and to investigate unresolved scientific problems makes access to remote natural areas a positive development for tourists and scientists alike.

Bài gốc thiếu phản biện này; bản gợi ý mượn lời đúng ở ý đối lập về truyền hình rồi giải thích điểm yếu của trải nghiệm qua màn hình.

criteria.title: Đúng đề và bám sát dàn ý Cô giao
evidence: I believe it is largely a negative trend because of its harmful effects on the environment.
On the other hand, I believe that the disadvantages of this development are more significant.
criteria.comment: Em trả lời được câu hỏi bằng một lập trường rõ, nhưng lập trường ấy ngược hướng có lợi đã giao. Đoạn về tác hại môi trường thay cho đoạn lợi ích khoa học; đoạn lợi ích đầu lại trộn nhà khoa học với du khách.
criteria.action: Viết lại mở bài và kết bài theo hướng tích cực; Body 1 dành cho du khách, Body 2 dành cho nhà khoa học theo đúng chuỗi dàn ý.

criteria.title: Giải thích ý và phản biện
evidence: tourism can provide people with unique experiences
This research may help them develop solutions to global environmental problems.
criteria.comment: Hai lợi ích em nêu mới ở mức khái quát. Chưa có chuỗi thích điều mới lạ → đến đảo ít người biết → trải nghiệm cụ thể; chưa có ý xem trên truyền hình và phản biện. Lợi ích khoa học chưa đi từ khoảng trống tri thức qua ví dụ virus, khí hậu đến chuẩn bị phòng dịch và phục hồi môi trường sống.
criteria.action: Bổ sung từng bước giải thích và ví dụ đúng nguồn, rồi chỉ ra vì sao xem qua màn hình kém trải nghiệm trực tiếp.

criteria.title: Vận dụng từ vựng và cấu trúc đã học
evidence: travelling to remote areas with natural environments, such as the South Pole, has become increasingly possible for scientists and tourists
This research may help them develop solutions to global environmental problems.
criteria.comment: Em dùng “may/can” đúng mức và câu viết có cấu trúc rõ. Mở bài vẫn giữ gần nguyên khung và nhiều từ của đề, nên chưa cho thấy cách diễn đạt lại linh hoạt. Ở phần nghiên cứu, em có cơ hội dùng bị động để nhấn vào điều được nghiên cứu hoặc môi trường sống được phục hồi.
criteria.action: Diễn đạt lại hiện tượng bằng cấu trúc riêng; khi viết lợi ích khoa học, thử “many questions remain unanswered” và “damaged habitats may be restored” đúng nghĩa.

criteria.title: Nối câu, nối đoạn và dùng từ thay thế
evidence: On the one hand, travelling to remote areas offers several advantages.
On the other hand, I believe that the disadvantages of this development are more significant.
criteria.comment: Các từ nối đối lập phù hợp với một bài lợi–hại, nhưng dẫn bài này sang hai phía trái với dàn ý. “This research” chỉ rõ hoạt động khám phá vừa nêu; em nên giữ kiểu quy chiếu rõ đó khi chuyển từ ví dụ khoa học sang kết quả.
criteria.action: Đổi mạch nối thành lợi ích cho du khách rồi lợi ích cho nhà khoa học; dùng từ chỉ kết quả để gắn ví dụ với ích lợi của nghiên cứu.

criteria.title: Viết chính xác và tự soát bài
evidence: Therefore, such activities should be carefully controlled to protect these natural environments for future generations.
criteria.comment: Câu, chia động từ và dấu câu nhìn chung chính xác; Cô không thấy lỗi ngữ pháp cơ bản cần gán thêm. Tuy vậy, bài có 249 từ theo cách đếm đã giao, thiếu 1 từ so với tối thiểu 250, và câu kết thêm giải pháp kiểm soát ngoài hướng bài tập.
criteria.action: Viết lại theo dàn ý để bổ sung nội dung thực chất và kiểm tra số từ đạt ít nhất 250; tự soát lại câu kết theo lập trường tích cực.
